description: A discarded local declaration does not prohibit an earlier stage from testing its feature (engine §13).

documents.p.md:

%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy

%features f

%rule text f? A
%redefine-stage second
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
